paragraphs.dominant_move: opens on a superlative crisis and then names the modeling job
stacks two purposes with and take into the consideration
walks the work in ordinals: in the first place, after that, next, in addition, as for, finally
reports a failed first model and the revision in the same breath
gives the fit as R=0.98 and later R=1, written tight against the number
closes the summary by bounding the model: reliable in small scale, needs advancement for larger
opens with a double subject and a verb that agrees with neither cleanly
stacks a ratio, a quote, and an attribution in one sentence
leaves a stray comma and a space before thus
cites a death toll and a grant rate with the source inline
lists the work as bullets, each one a we-verb plus a method plus a source

global_organization_chain: Report the first model as a failure, with its correlation
Quote the borrowed formula before changing it
Overlay the failure, the repair and the data on one chart
Translate each weighting back into a route choice
Keep the wrong forecast and name the geography that caused it
Read the policy off the figure, then write the letter

main_argument_chains.claim: A gravity weight repaired after a failed equal-weight baseline, checked quarter by quarter and closed at capacity, routes refugees while a larger capacity keeps the flow stable.
support_steps: Reject the equal-weight run at correlation 0.6543
Rebuild the weight from safety, convenience and repatriation
Match the route split at correlation 0.9914
Move a fraction each quarter and close saturated nodes
Show the model failing beyond its map
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Enlarge capacity to steady the flow, announce an official route, and stock resources where the flow stays large.

warnings.warning: The distance average prints the divisor on one line and the sum on the next. The recorded form uses one fifth of the five retained routes.
The safety index prints with the fraction and the flags scattered. The recorded form follows the prose: one minus danger per unit distance.
The combined weight mixes safety, convenience and repatriation on one broken line. The recorded form keeps the three logarithms.
The arrival sum prints its indices and its fraction on separate lines. The recorded form uses the prose statement of one over n.
The cobweb is drawn without an equation. The recorded rule states only the comparison the two figures make.
